_note: Spec 12.5 - verified page numbers for the demo documents, to be used as the hardcoded fallback in backend/pages.py. find_pages() does locate all four sections on Seacera, but it also returns notes-section noise, so ship this fallback and treat the matcher as the optimisation. All page numbers are 1-BASED PDF pages, matching fixtures/mock_extraction.json and the page images backend/ingest.py must render.

seacera.unit_note: Statements are printed in FULL RINGGIT, not RM'000. find_pages() must not require an RM'000 header to filter false positives on this document.
seacera.rotated_note: The statement of changes in equity is printed sideways. pdfplumber returns those words with upright=false and the characters REVERSED ('081,617,63' for 36,716,180). backend/bbox.py must compare the reversed string too or retained_earnings resolves to a null bbox and goes UNVERIFIED.

market_data.source: Financial Highlights, page 19 of the report itself
market_data.note: Printed in the document, so the listed-company Altman variant needs no network call. share_price_1y is derived from the two market caps; share count is unchanged year on year (treasury shares constant at 180,945). Use THIS figure for the FY2024 Altman Z - it is contemporaneous with the statements.

since_the_report.note: Context only, NOT an input to the FY2024 Z-score. During FY2024 itself the market cap rose 19.4% (111.99m -> 133.76m), so the market agreed with management at the time. It is the two years since that repriced the company. Keep those two periods distinct if this comes up - conflating them would be the same sloppiness we are criticising.

khee_san.rejection_reason: Fails spec 12.4 check 3: total equity is NEGATIVE at -RM76,629,109 (accumulated losses of RM204.0m against RM112.2m share capital). Spec 12.3 warns this exact case - gearing and ROE blow up on a negative denominator and Altman X4 goes negative. The report also carries a qualified opinion, a material uncertainty on going concern and an unapproved Regularisation Plan, which is the FY T profile 12.3 says to avoid. Spec 12.4: 'Fails 1, 2 or 3 -> next candidate. Do not try to fix it.'
khee_san.keep_as: Contrast document only. Useful for showing the schema failing loudly on a company it was not designed for, if there is spare time - never as the primary demo.
